Section 1 directs that the BECC and NADBank Agreement be implemented consistently with U.S. policy for the protection of human, animal or plant life or health and the environment, and to advance sustainable development and public participation. EO 13380 section 1(a) inserted the Protocol of Amendment words after 'North American Development Bank'; the clause continues as amended and the Code note prints it as amended.

Terminated on 2005-06-17. EO 13380 section 1(b) amended Executive Order 12916 'by striking section 2 and inserting in lieu thereof' a new section 2; the original section 2(a) (the EPA Administrator and the U.S. Commissioner of the International Boundary and Water Commission represent the United States as Members of the Board of the BECC) is not carried into the replacement text, which assigns Board membership to the Secretaries of State and the Treasury and the EPA Administrator, provides for presidential appointments and the Treasury chair, and assigns coordination to the Secretary of the Treasury. The substance changed, so this clause is recorded as ended by amendment rather than as continuing; a human reviewer should compare the original and replacement text. EO 13380 has no separate effective date and so took effect on signing.

research_rationale:
EO 12916 (59 FR 25779, signed 1994-05-13, published 1994-05-18) implements the Border Environment Cooperation Commission (BECC) and North American Development Bank (NADBank) agreement and the community adjustment and investment provisions of the NAFTA Implementation Act. I read the held Federal Register text in full (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12916.txt, an OCR text layer with recognition errors; the text is read against the Code note, which reproduces the amended order). The inventory is sections 1-11 split into 18 clauses. EO 13380 (signed 2005-06-17, no separate effective date, so effective on signing; 70 FR 35509) amended the order: it inserted words in section 1; struck section 2 and inserted a new section 2; struck subsections 3(a), 3(b) and 3(c), struck the designation '(d)' and replaced 'representatives' in what is now section 3; replaced 'Advisory Committee' in section 6; and changed 'Members' to 'members' in section 7(c). The current U.S. Code note under 19 U.S.C. 3473 prints the order as amended, with sections 1, 3 (the former 3(d)), 4-11 as in the original text as so amended and a new section 2. Under the owner's strike-and-insert ruling of 2026-10-21 a clause whose words are struck and replaced continues as amended (sections 1, 3(d), 6, 7(c)). The original text of sections 2(a), 2(b), 2(c), 3(a), 3(b) and 3(c) was struck by EO 13380 and is not carried into the replacement text, so those six clauses are recorded as terminated on 2005-06-17 by express amendment; a human reviewer should note that the substance of section 2 changed (the new section 2 assigns Board membership to the Secretaries of State and the Treasury and the EPA Administrator and has no counterpart to the former International Boundary and Water Commission and interagency coordination clauses). Remaining sections 4-11 appear unchanged in the Code note, which reproduces them. Continuation orders (EO 13708, 13811, 13889, 14048, 14109, 14354) list the Good Neighbor Environmental Board under Executive Order 12916; EO 14354 (2025-09-29) continues it until September 30, 2027 and is recorded as a continuation event on section 10. The bounded searches found no revocation. The text relied on is the held official Federal Register text for the original and for EO 13380; no transcription is used.
